This is how you make the perfect carbonara every time. All you need for a good carbonara is some good guanciale, some egg yolks, a nice blend of Parmigiano Reggiano and pecorino romano, and some good black pepper. We're gonna take the guanciale, clean it, and it's gonna end up like this. At this point, we're gonna slice it and make a little strips. And we're gonna cut about 50 grams every person. Next is the cheese. 50 grams of a blend of Parmigiano Reggiano and pecorino romano. Next is the eggs. Two egg yolks per person. Very important, the black pepper in the carbonara. Very, very important. A lot of black pepper. Thick. Mix it. Now it's very thick. Leave it on the side. Now, the important thing is the guanciale. You want it crispy like french fries. So, medium hot the pan. Put your guanciale inside. No oil, nothing. The guanciale has a lot of fat and it's gonna fry in its own fat. There we go, now, you see. Remove the guanciale from the pan and keep the fat inside the pan. Some of the fat. A little bit. We're gonna put it inside here. There we go, now. You see, you don't need cream. Now that we got all ready, we can start our pasta. A little bit of salt, not too much this time. Guanciale is very salty. Spaghetti, a must. While your pasta's cooking, we're gonna warm up the bowl with the cheese and the eggs. Yeah, you don't want this bowl to be cold. You're gonna put the pasta inside the pan. Add the pasta to the guanciale, the guanciale fat. Now we're gonna add a little bit more pasta water. We're gonna add some of the guanciale now and the rest for decoration on top. Most people, they make the mistake of making scrambled eggs. So, they take this cheese and eggs and they put it inside there. This is mistake number one. What you do is do the opposite. You do this.
